fusions.name: Forty Miles Behind
fusions.desc: A lunge that deals 30 damage to the first enemy it meets and is always a critical hit. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 40%).

fusions.name: Wearing Them Down
fusions.desc: A nip at the heels that deals 4 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at its full reach of 3 tiles, and slows the target 15% for 2 seconds. Your movement speed rises 10% for 3 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Ground-Eating Lope
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 30% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Trail-Hardened
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, you regain 6 stamina. Once every 5 seconds.
